[spoiler=Military research]
[b]Frigg A35CIWS weapon system and Sif-class corvettes[/b]
The two prototype Sif-class corvettes was finaly finished in the Nordland shipyards and would begin their sea and combat systems trails and testing, the combat system tests would be done with both simulated and live testing ageinst dummy drones and missiles to see how well the systems did at sea were weapons "plattform" would be moving with the waves of the sea to judge the targeting systems ability to aquire and track targets for accurate fireing of the new A35CIWS weapon system.
The two ships had slightly different loadout with one having been given two of the A35CIWS while the other only had one together with a standard turreted 76mm Cannon that was being planed for use in a coastal defence version, a 3rd prototype version with a VLS was being made to investigate the possibility of a small and fast missile ship using the same hull.

[b]Platypus Turrets[/b]
The first turret with the 105mm cannon have passed its last combat trail and have been given its first orders by the Nordiheimian military, the production is scheduled to start next month.
The turret with the 120mm cannon still have more test to be conducted to figure out its needed configurations and to iron out some remaining gun system bugs because of the change in purpose introduced in the middel of its devlopment to become a SPG type turret instead of the originaly intended AT type turret, though so far the results have been good, it is belived that it will potentialy be finished before the end of the year.

[b]40mm AHEAD development[/b]
Nonitions AS have anounced that the creation of a larger AHEAD caliber will be possible and have started the prosses of designing and creating a prototype batch of the larger caliber amunition so that the Nordiheimian military can cunduct vigorous testing with it.
It is however not certain exactly when this first batch of 40 mm AHEAD amunition will be ready for testing though a representative from Nonitions AS have commented that they will anounce one as soon as they have a good enough idea of the time window needed as they desire to deliver a product that will achive success and confidence in their ability to deliver said amunition. 
[/spoiler]

[b]Kornoliv Admin. 2027[/b]
[sub]Expansion Post[/sub]]

The Sikirskian Kornoliv Territories have been around for some time already. This land is an Federal Autonomous Zone. A title given to areas of Sikirsk which have special independent features. However that doesn't matter at this moment. 

[i][b]Directive 610.[/b][/i]

[i]Federal Directive of Territorial Expansion and Integration[/i]

[i]Issued: 18 March 2027[/i]

Following a comprehensive strategic, economic, and security review of the eastern sector of West Shamat, the Federal Directorate hereby authorizes Directive 610, initiating the controlled southern expansion of the Kornoliv Territories. All information regarding the directive shall be listed below in 6 categories.

[b]I. Security and Military Measures
[/b]

Federal Armed Forces units are authorized to advance southward into the Kornoliv Expansion Zone to secure all population centers, transport corridors, ports, and resource sites. As well as eliminating all bandit formations, irregular militias, and armed actors in the zone. The establishment of permanent permanent garrison zones and forward logistics bases shall be overseen by the Ministry of Defense and the Ministry of the Interior. A series of loosened military restrictions shall be imposed during this part of the operation.

[b]II. Civilian Administration and Governance[/b]

A Provisional South Kornoliv Civil Administration (PSKCA) shall be established immediately following military stabilization. This temporary administration shall join the rest of Kornoliv after the success of the directive. The PKCA shall restore basic law enforcement and security measures, register all existent local population and property. Aside from that, courts, customs offices, and administrative districts shall be put in place and all other local law or rules shall be changed to Sikirskian law. And all administration shall operate under direct federal oversight until permanent territorial statutes are enacted.

[b]III. Economic Integration and Infrastructure[/b]

Directive 610 enforces that new territories must be fully integrated into Sikirsks national infrastructure systems, these include: 

- Extension of rail, highway, and energy grids from northern Kornoliv into the south

- Connection to Sikirskian telecommunications and data networks

- Restoration and expansion of ports, industrial terminals, and logistics hubs

All infrastructural assets in the area, which have been inactive do to the absence of governance, shall be seized by the PSKCA instantly.

[b]IV. Coastal Development and Urban Construction[/b]

The Eastern coastline of the region shall be put under a Strategic Economic Development Zone. As it seen as of great importance to the Federation.

Authorized permissions include:

- Construction of new port facilities and maritime trade hubs

- Establishment of shipyards, energy terminals, and export-processing zones

- Planned construction of a [b]new coastal city[/b], designed as a federal administrative, industrial, and population center

Said city will function as a southern capital of the Kornoliv Territories, but also as a major adminstrative-trade hub between Sikirsk and East Shamat. And other factors that have been classified until further notice.

[b]V. Final Information[/b]

Directive 610 remains in force until the Kornoliv Expansion Zone is fully stabilized, integrated, and completly reorganized under Federatsiya territorial law. 

If locals fail to comply with this directive in any way, that shall be treated as a full breach of federal authority.

[b]Over and out...[/b]

[u][b][i]Glory to the Federation.
[/u][/b][/i]

[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]La Marcha del Estado: La Expansión Nacional (1980-1984)[/b]
[i]Erene:2000 Expansion Roleplay[/i]]

[b][December 7th, 1980]
[/b]
It was a sweltering hot summer day in Luscária, the Sun was bearing down causing the streets to smoke. Children could be seen running through the streets chasing after one another, the streets were bustling with life, the honking of cars, the loud voices of passerbys. But far away from all the liveliness there was a large conference room, despite being well lit there was a heavy darkness enshrouding the place, a suffocating stale air and the thick stench of a cigar all backdropped by the constant ticking of a clock. In the room was Caudillo Luis Garcia Rodriguez, State Marshal Pablo Escobar, Minister of State Security Juan Bautista Topete, and Minister of Finance Raúl Chibás. The four men were gathered around a couple maps, there was a detailed map of Luscária alongside the maps of Southwest Vespurias and a global map of Erene, on the maps one could spot many circled areas, potential points of interest and small notes written besides them detailing an estimated value of each area and the potential dangers to be found there.

Today was not like any other day, Caudillo Luis G. Rodriguez had been making plans for years now, all leading up to this moment. It was February 13th, 1967 when his predecessor launched El Sendero de las Lágrimas, it was a special operation with the purpose of reclaiming rightful Luscárian land and returning order to the surrounding areas. During El Sendero de las Lágrimas the SVA (State Vanguard Army) was tasked with securing the borders of Luscária, reclaiming the land to the East, ensuring the compliance of any native tribes found in the area, and the elimination of any destabilizing factors in the surrounding area. For 2 years 1 month and 8 days the SVA would continue its relentless march eastward, carefully relocating countless natives, and crushing the budding nations of the war lords and illegal breakaways who dared to occupy Luscárian land. March 21st, 1969 on this day El Sendero de las Lágrimas would come to an end as a massive success, expanding the Luscárian borders by 428,000 km^2 and setting the foundation for further expansion. Another period of rapid development and stabilization would be brought about and would continue until today, Caudillo Rodriguez had long been making plans to commence an operation of even larger scale than El Sendero de las Lágrimas.

[b][July 23rd, 1984]
[/b]
The Southern islands had been securely held for a couple weeks at this point, it seemed that soon La Marcha del Estado would come to an end as a great success. But today high command had received some special information, information regarding the Callistan territories. For a long time now Callista had us fooled that they held an iron grip over the South Coast of Southwest Vespurias, but investigations performed by agents in the area have found that that is not quite true. There exists an area which has pushed back against the Callistans and continuously denied their attempts to conquer them, this area was instead ruled by anthropomorphic Jaguar people.

Should we prepare our forces to invade the area? asked State Marshal Escobar.

No not yet. Have them ready to be transported at any moment, but dont send them out yet. I know of a [i]much[/i] better way to deal with that little zoo. Caudillo Rodriguez responded, a sharp light appearing in his eyes as the corner of his mouth rose. Call in Jorge, I have some ideas to discuss with him.

[b][July 31st, 1984]
[/b]
Two men could be seen on the beach, one of them was fully engulfed within a red and gold robe, while the other man was visibly bruised and chained. Let us see, according to the book once weve made it to the target area we can begin to set up the summoning circle. First we need to draw the portal to our dimension in a ring of animal blood. Then we have to set a person of tainted belief on fire in the center of the circle. Finally while you burn alive I have to recite a certain incantation in Latin. Well then, that seems simple enough, I see no reason to keep the Caudillo waiting any longer than necessary. muttered the robed man, Jorge Tomaz.

He pulled out a jug of blood from within his robes, dipped his fingers in the blood and began to draw an intricate portal to another dimension on the sand. By the time the blood in the jug had ran out Jorge had managed to finish the portal. He then grabbed the bruised man and threw him into the circle, he had been drugged before Jorge had even begun to ensure his compliance, so he just stood there staring blankly into the sky as Jorge doused him in gasoline before throwing a lit match on him. The blood curdling screams of the man could be heard crying out throughout the entire area, Hmm, at least in your final moments you serve some kind of use. Consider yourself lucky, you commie bastard, that we werent blessed with the chance to torture you for far longer. Jorge cruelly remarked before opening the old weathered book he held and beginning to recite the incantation to summon Him.[/spoiler]
